presets.name: Bare
presets.summary: Plain pot, no pattern and no blush.
presets.description: Two optional components off at once. What is left is the plant, the pot and the face, which is the whole idea of the style at its simplest.

presets.name: Sepia
presets.summary: A dried-out plant in a terracotta pot.
presets.description: Three mouth variants are excluded. They show a pink tongue painted into the artwork rather than taking a color option, and one pink tongue undoes the whole set.

presets.name: Greyscale
presets.summary: No hue on plant, pot or bloom.
presets.description: The style leans on flat shapes and a hard drop shadow, both of which survive losing color. Same mouth exclusion as Sepia.

presets.name: Duotone
presets.summary: One sage green, one cream pot.
presets.description: Two colors and a shadow. Only the species of plant and the expression change from avatar to avatar.

presets.name: Muted
presets.description: The style ships bright pots and eight greens at full brightness. These are the same plants in tones that hold still, which suits a shelf of thirty of them. The tongue mouths are excluded, the same ones the monochrome presets drop, because their pink is painted in rather than picked.

presets.name: Electric
presets.description: Only one layer goes loud. Neon pots under neon foliage would cancel each other out, so the plant keeps the palette it was born with.

presets.name: Pastel Wall
presets.description: Every background the style ships is dark and saturated. Pale ones turn the same plant from a spotlit specimen into something sitting on a windowsill.

presets.name: Bold Pop
presets.description: Louder than the shipped set and pushed toward the primaries. The pot and plant are both pale enough to hold their edge against it.

presets.name: Night Shift
presets.description: For dark interfaces. Both the pot palette and the greens are already light, so nothing else has to move for the plant to stay visible.

presets.name: Sunrise
presets.summary: A warm gradient behind the pot.
presets.description: Shows the gradient background options: two colors, a linear fill and a fixed angle. The seed still decides which of the two ends up on top, so the light comes from either side across a set.

presets.name: Full Cast
presets.summary: Every pot patterned, every face blushing.
presets.description: Both optional components turned all the way up. The style ships six pot patterns that most seeds never reach at the default probability.

presets.name: Animated
presets.summary: Turns the style's built-in animation on.
presets.description: The animation is off by default and `animation: true` switches it on. A list like `animation: ['blink']` plays just that one, and `animationSpeed` sets the pace. The motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
